main_measure.name: mean excess next-bar return (forecast > 0 bars minus coin holding mean)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2.0; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2.0; else inconclusive; at least 200 forecast > 0 bars

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess next-bar return on forecast size

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2.0 and 2.0, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Uptrend checked on the recorded regime label 'trending' and the drop as a negative 1-day return (down_day raw value, else close-to-close); the holding mean is each coin's mean next-bar return over all windows present in the record (12 here, not 24); fewer than 200 bars is reported as not observable per the minimum-count rule; the supporting slope passes if positive.
